symptom: `tabpage tp (Caption: 'a', Visible: roles (Wd.Viewer))` was refused by `check` under mdl 1 (MDL-WIDGET44 "`VisibleRoles` cannot be stored on a tab page") and warned about headerless (MDL-V1-TABPAGEPROP "not written"), though the roles are written, describe prints them back and MxBuild 11.16.1 accepts an own-module role on a tab page.
cause: tabPageStoredProps is a hand-kept allowlist of the keys buildTabPageV3 writes. #1460 made the builder write VisibleRoles through childVisibility, and #1465 added the refusal for every known widget property the list did not name; the two never met, so the new key was refused as dropped.
insight: **A refusal built from an allowlist of what a builder writes goes stale the day the builder learns a new key, and it fails closed: it blocks a feature that works.** The test that settles it is two-sided: build the AST through the real builder and assert the stored field (TestTabPage_VisibleRolesIsWritten passed before the fix, which is what proved the refusal was the wrong half), then assert check does not refuse (failed before, with the reported message). Found while measuring a different gap: Visible: roles naming another module's role is CE0149 on a container, dynamic text, layout-grid row, navigation-list item, snippet container and tab page alike (own-module role clean everywhere), but the tab page case could not even be reached under mdl 1 because of this refusal. The cross-module check is a separate change. The message also named VisibleRoles when it sat beside a real offender (CaptionParams); that goes with the fix since the key is no longer listed. Badge keys were checked and are not affected: they are not page-widget properties, so tabPageDroppedProps never reaches them.
